summary: RptMnuEmploymentChanges is a partial class in the HSPnet.UserControls.ReportMenu namespace, which is part of an ASP.NET Web Forms application. It handles the generation of a report regarding employment changes, allowing users to export data in CSV format.
purpose: The purpose of RptMnuEmploymentChanges is to facilitate the generation and display of employment change reports within the application, providing options for filters and exporting results.

workflows.name: Generate Employment Changes Report
steps: User specifies start and end dates.
User selects employment status options: Newly Employed, Newly Resigned, or Both.
User clicks 'Run Excel' to generate the report.
System sets appropriate stored procedure based on user role.
System adds parameters to database call.
System executes stored procedure and retrieves data.
CSV is displayed in lblReportHTML if generated successfully.

business_rules: If UserSession.PlacementCoordinator is true, use 'ReportEmploymentChangesPA' procedure; otherwise, use 'ReportEmploymentChanges'.
Parameters 'EmployStatus1' and 'EmployStatus2' are set based on selected radio buttons for employment status.
validations: RegularExpressionValidator1 ensures the date format is correct for txtStartDate.
valEditStartDate and valEditEndDate are required field validators for start and end dates.
conditions: If UserSession is not null, retrieve report details and options from Codes.CodeLookupCodes.
system_behavior: Sets up JavaScript declarations for client-side manipulation.
Displays report as HTML in pnlReportHTML when data retrieval and CSV generation are successful.
